title: Bali-mazer (Baal-Manzer) of Tyre
summary: Tyrian whose tribute Shalmaneser III claims on the Black Obelisk; Griffith & White hold he was the high priest of Baal Melqart, not a king.
description: Named Ba-’a-li-ma-an-zer of Tyre in Shalmaneser III’s inscription. Griffith & White (Reply to Beckman, Parts 2–3) argue, after Aaronson, that he was probably the high priest of Baal Melqart in Tyre rather than King Badezorus (Baal-Ezer II), and date the tribute claim circa 841 BC, perhaps two or three decades after it was paid. Person record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman (OSF project 5b64m) on 2026-11-13.
